name: Pal♡world! ~More Than Just Pals~
source:
What lies inside the mysterious World Tree? An exciting school life filled with cute Pals! Will you remain friends or fall in love? Or dismantle and eat them...🍴 Your dream school romance starts here in this Palworld dating sim!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620480]Steam[/url]]
translation:
神秘的世界树里到底藏着什么？充满可爱伙伴的精彩校园生活！你们会继续做朋友还是坠入爱河？或者拆解并吃掉它们…🍴 你梦想的校园浪漫故事就在这款Palworld约会模拟游戏中开始！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620480]Steam[/url]]
